network_limits: Sampled main-process listeners/connections only, not whole-tree packet capture or a firewall/anonymity attestation. Actual profile uses fixed verified files, loopback, offline mode and no tools/cloud routes.

resources.scope: Main model-server process only; runtime children, Python worker/indexer and OS excluded. Lifetime peak includes development. Shared PC; observations are not total memory, minimum hardware or energy estimates. Window includes fresh indexing and bookkeeping.

retention: Verified model/runtime and checkpoints remain ignored locally. No prompts, raw responses, hidden reasoning, private queries or human-review data published. No model download, paid API or hosted inference used in this run.
